The customer dimension is an SCD2 table. 30 customers have two rows: an old one with is_current=False and a current one with is_current=True. The join to silver_customers therefore duplicates transactions for those customers, which explains 5251 vs 4558. The extra 693 rows is plausible given 30 of the 200 customers are duplicated.

The fix is to keep only current rows in silver_customers. All 200 customers have exactly one current row (is_current=True: 200, distinct=200), so the dedupe is unambiguous.

An open question is whether transactions should map to the region in effect at transaction time. The old rows have valid_from 2023-06-01 and the current rows 2025-01-01. All transactions are from January 2026, after both valid_from dates, so the current row applies to every transaction. This makes the choice unambiguous.

The fix filters silver_customers to `WHERE is_current`, keeping the same columns.
